2026 · IEEE Transactions on Magnetics

Wafer-scale estimation of thermal stability with magneto-optical measurement system for STT-MRAM

Kenji Suzuki · Ingi Kim · Shinji Ueyama · Junho Shin · Je Ung Song · Wookrae Kim · Taehyun Kim · Junho Jeong · Sangwoo Bae · Sungho Jang · Jeong-heon Park · Myungjun Lee

Developed a 300 mm wafer-compatible MOKE system with a temperature-controlled chuck and purpose-built electromagnet. The system resolves magnetic anisotropy at 20 μm and maps STT-MRAM thermal stability at 150 °C.

Non-contact and nanometer-scale measurement of PN junction depth buried in Si wafers using terahertz emission spectroscopy

Fumikazu Murakami · Shinji Ueyama · Kenji Suzuki · Ingi Kim · Inkeun Baek · Sangwoo Bae · Dougyong Sung · Myungjun Lee · Sungyoon Ryu · Yusin Yang · Masayoshi Tonouchi

Demonstrated that the amplitude and polarity of laser-induced terahertz emission encode buried PN-junction depth and carrier dynamics, enabling non-contact, non-destructive junction-depth metrology with nanometer-scale accuracy.

Fig. 2 · Time-dependent SHG response
2023 · Proceedings of SPIE 12569, 1256904

Characterization of interface charge traps in PE-TEOS and HDP oxide with different annealing temperatures using time-dependent second-harmonic generation

Ingi Kim · Suhwan Park · Minhwan Seo · Sunhong Jun · Sungyoon Ryu · Sangwoo Bae · Namil Koo · Yusin Yang

Used time-dependent second-harmonic generation to probe charge traps at SiO₂/Si interfaces in PE-TEOS and HDP oxides. The optical response distinguishes annealing-dependent trap density and charge polarity.
